description: 5G Open Radio Access Network Multi-Modal Intrusion Detection Dataset (NetsLab-5GORAN-IDD) is a data set described in the paper "5G Open Radio Access Network Multi-Modal Intrusion Detection Dataset (NetsLab-5GORAN-IDD)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2025), produced by Farah Abed Zadeh, Alan Civciss, Vidura Ravihansa and colleagues. The rise of open radio access networks (O-RANs) in 5G introduces flexibility and interoperability and expands the attack surface due to its cloud-native, multi-vendor architecture. Coverage: an open RAN testbed. The data are held on Kaggle, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support open radio access network intrusion detection studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
